subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should Voice/Talk share the Chat session selection, expose a separate Voice-specific agent picker, or remain tied to the gateway default session for now?
rationale: Current source proves the remaining gap, but the permanent UX and session-state policy affect companion-app behavior and cannot be chosen safely by cleanup automation.

options.title: Share Chat selection
options.body: Route Voice/Talk through the same selected session model as Chat so one mobile session choice controls typed and spoken turns.

options.title: Separate Voice picker
options.body: Add a Voice/Talk-specific agent/session picker with its own persisted state, accepting the extra session-state and discoverability surface.

options.title: Defer switching
options.body: Keep Voice/Talk bound to the gateway default session and leave multi-agent voice switching out until companion-app voice UX is redesigned.

recommendation.title: Share Chat selection
recommendation.body: Route Voice/Talk through the same selected session model as Chat so one mobile session choice controls typed and spoken turns.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already scoped the completed TTS half and the remaining Talk/Voice session-selection half in the issue discussion.
